name: RU-28306
summary: RU-28306, also known as UCD0094 or as 4,α-methylene-N,N-dimethyltryptamine (4,α-methylene-DMT), is a non-selective serotonin receptor agonist as well as dopamine receptor agonist. It is a cyclized tryptamine, specifically a conformationally restricted tricyclic derivative of dimethyltryptamine (DMT), and can also be considered a partial ergoline or simplified and deconstructed analogue of LSD.
